gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Founded in 1850 by our great grandfather, Abele farms is home to 1000 acres of beautifully rich land that provides nourishment to the growth of almonds and cattle grazing that has thrived for six generations. Alongside that, our farm is located in the middle of the beautiful countryside of Yolo Country making it the perfect place to host any type of event.
